title: At powers of two the cut-open torus's spectrum is a trace polynomial with matrix coefficients
subject: Networks of rings joined by shared contacts, read with the canonical knot test on their space-time law
conclusion: At sides 2^m the cut-open torus's cone polynomial is the determinant of a linearized polynomial in which the trace of GF(2n) has its scalar coefficients replaced by matrices over GF(2), built digit by digit from a one-by-one matrix; without one reversal the same return map has exactly the trace-1 elements of GF(n) as eigenvalues. Why every root lies in GF(2n) is reduced to that determinant and stays open.
